# Connection Management

Connections (credentials + endpoints per app) — list, by app, read, create, update, delete, test.

7 operation(s). Base URL `https://vannbros-qa.burqio.site`; `{version}` in a path is `1`. Calls need `Authorization: Bearer <token>` (see ../SKILL.md). **Read-only for QA:** only GETs, and not the GETs SKILL.md lists as side-effecting.

| POST | [`/api/v{version}/Connections`](#op-connections-create) | Connections_Create |
| GET | [`/api/v{version}/Connections/getByAppId`](#op-connections-getbyappid) | Connections_GetByAppId |

| DELETE | [`/api/v{version}/Connections/{id}`](#op-connections-delete) | Connections_Delete |
| POST | [`/api/v{version}/Connections/test`](#op-connections-testconnection) | Connections_TestConnection |
